before: A distributed line stretches only its spaces, and a line with nothing to stretch stays at its start edge.
after: In a legacy compatibility mode, or in a modern mode with a w:rPrDefault element in the styles part, each line of a left-to-right distributed paragraph spreads its slack after every character once its spaces have taken their share. In a modern mode, a run with pair kerning on (w:kern not 0 and at most its size) keeps its letters together and stretches only at its spaces and East Asian characters. Otherwise it stretches its spaces, and a line with nothing to stretch is centered. Tabs and float advances keep their reserved positions.
reason: Only layout geometry and paint change. Canonical OOXML, source positions, operations, and collaboration formats remain unchanged. Every peer derives the same geometry from the same styles and settings parts.
